datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: CRISM Full Resolution targeted (FRT) mode observation FRT00003192_07
datasets.instrument_sensor: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM)
datasets.target_name: Gusev Crater (Columbia Hills: Husband Hill, El Dorado, Inner Basin/Home Plate)
datasets.measurement_observable: Hyperspectral imaging spectra/radiance modeled to retrieve surface Lambert albedo spectra; analysis of spectral signatures dominated by ferric-rich dust, olivine, and pyroxene
datasets.wavelength_bandpass: 0.4–4.0 µm (545 bands); example composite used bands 1098 nm (blue), 1518 nm (green), 2528 nm (red)
datasets.data_type_product_type: Hyperspectral image cube (targeted FRT mode); retrieved surface spectra (Lambert albedo) from modeled CRISM radiances
datasets.acquisition_date_time_range: Acquired over Columbia Hills and surrounding plains while Spirit was located at the Low Ridge winter campaign site (near-simultaneous with Spirit atmospheric optical depth measurements); Spirit sols 805–1037 referenced for winter campaign context
datasets.location_coverage: Columbia Hills and surrounding cratered plains in Gusev Crater; ~10 km frame width; Mars equirectangular projection (as used in Figure 1)
datasets.how_used: Primary orbital dataset analyzed: CRISM radiances were atmospherically modeled (DISORT) using rover atmospheric constraints to retrieve surface Lambert albedo spectra; spectra were searched for signatures of alteration minerals and compared against Spirit ground truth, concluding orbital spectra are dominated by dust/mafic minerals at 18 m/pixel scale.

datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: CTX image frame PSP_001513_1654_XI_14S184W_061122 (used with CRISM composite)
datasets.measurement_observable: Image intensity used to sharpen fine detail in a CRISM-based false color infrared composite
datasets.location_coverage: Columbia Hills region of Gusev Crater, used as intensity/sharpening component for the Figure 1 CRISM false color composite
datasets.how_used: CTX image data were used as the high-spatial-frequency intensity layer to sharpen and enhance fine geomorphic detail in the CRISM false-color infrared composite used for regional context.

datasets.pds_dataset_product_name: HiRISE image PSP_001513_1655_red (used for traverse/experiment site mapping and as map base)

datasets.how_used: HiRISE provided the base map for plotting Spirit traverses and experiment sites; rover positions for specific sols were precisely located on the HiRISE image using rover landmarks and cross-checked against bundle-adjusted positions, enabling spatial context for surface/orbital comparisons.

queries.query: I need Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter CRISM full-resolution targeted hyperspectral cubes (0.4–4.0 µm, ~18 m/pixel) over Gusev Crater’s Columbia Hills during the early MRO science phase (roughly late 2006 through mid 2007) to quantify pixel-scale spectral mixing between ferric dust and mafic minerals (olivine/pyroxene) across light-toned versus dark ripple deposits.

I need CRISM-derived nadir atmospheric gas retrievals (CO2-related surface pressure proxy, water vapor column, and CO mixing ratio) spanning early MRO operations (mid-2006 through ~2012) to provide atmospheric-state constraints for DISORT-based radiative transfer correction when retrieving Lambert albedo spectra from CRISM targeted observations over Gusev Crater.

output_parsed.paper_title: Spirit Mars Rover Mission to the Columbia Hills, Gusev Crater: Mission overview and selected results from the Cumberland Ridge to Home Plate

queries.query: For MRO CTX imaging used to provide ~6 m/pixel geomorphic context over the Columbia Hills in Gusev crater (e.g., as a high-spatial-frequency intensity layer for sharpening co-registered hyperspectral composites), I need the authoritative CTX instrument metadata: wavelength bandpass, native pixel scale/FOV, and any key observation/processing notes relevant to interpreting image radiometry and geometric fidelity.

To place MRO CTX regional-context imaging of the Columbia Hills in Gusev crater into the correct operational and instrument context, I need the MRO mission-level metadata (mission start/stop, instrument complement, and basic mission description) to constrain the relevant observation era and coordination with other MRO instruments.

final_output.query: I need Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter CRISM full-resolution targeted hyperspectral cubes (0.4–4.0 µm, ~18 m/pixel) over Gusev Crater’s Columbia Hills during the early MRO science phase (roughly late 2006 through mid 2007) to quantify pixel-scale spectral mixing between ferric dust and mafic minerals (olivine/pyroxene) across light-toned versus dark ripple deposits.

I need CRISM-derived nadir atmospheric gas retrievals (CO2-related surface pressure proxy, water vapor column, and CO mixing ratio) spanning early MRO operations (mid-2006 through ~2012) to provide atmospheric-state constraints for DISORT-based radiative transfer correction when retrieving Lambert albedo spectra from CRISM targeted observations over Gusev Crater.

For MRO CTX imaging used to provide ~6 m/pixel geomorphic context over the Columbia Hills in Gusev crater (e.g., as a high-spatial-frequency intensity layer for sharpening co-registered hyperspectral composites), I need the authoritative CTX instrument metadata: wavelength bandpass, native pixel scale/FOV, and any key observation/processing notes relevant to interpreting image radiometry and geometric fidelity.

To place MRO CTX regional-context imaging of the Columbia Hills in Gusev crater into the correct operational and instrument context, I need the MRO mission-level metadata (mission start/stop, instrument complement, and basic mission description) to constrain the relevant observation era and coordination with other MRO instruments.

I need the MRO HiRISE red-channel reduced-data record image over Gusev Crater that covers the Columbia Hills traverse corridor so I can georeference Spirit rover traverse segments and map experiment-site context at meter-scale for geomorphic interpretation.

Locate the HiRISE red-filter map-projected scene from MRO spanning the Husband Hill–Haskin Ridge–Home Plate sector of Gusev Crater to build a high-resolution basemap for correlating surface observations with orbital-scale geologic contacts and aeolian bedform distributions.

For the MER Spirit rover in Gusev crater (Columbia Hills), I need the derived Pancam color mosaic acquired on sol 549 over the layered outcrops on the western flank of Husband Hill to map bedding/joint orientations and quantify albedo/texture contrasts across the stratigraphic section.

Compile Mini-TES thermal-IR (5–29 µm) mirror-dust-corrected emissivity spectra from the MER Spirit rover for the Columbia Hills/Home Plate operational interval to deconvolve amorphous (glassy) versus crystalline silicate components and evaluate dust-versus-substrate mixing in outcrops and aeolian deposits.
